tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per tender notification and Bid document
Minimum service charges to be quoted by bidder is 1%, if any bidder quotes less than 1% such bidder will be rejected and their EMD will be forefitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The company/firm should have been in the business of providing manpower services for last 5 financial years.,( 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26) and should have provided satisfactorily minimum 2 manpower service per year in a single order to any Government offices/Government undertakings. Certificates issued by the officer not below the rank of EE or Equivalent.

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA DEPARTMENT OF LABOUR. REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE OF ESTABLISHMENT FORM-C (See Rule 4) The Agency should have valid registration certificate of establishment issued under Karnataka shops and commercial establishment act of 1961, according to government of Karnataka, department of labour and should have registered with minimum 2 labours engaged should be uploaded.
Karnataka Labour welfare fund (1965 Act) remitted receipts for the past five years 2021,2022,2023,2024 and 2025 with minimum 2 persons.

EPF REMITTANCE STATEMENT : The agency must have valid EPF registration certificate and EPF remittance statement minimum for Rs.1.44 lakhs (25% estimated cost)per Annum for having remitted for the past five financial years,2021-22,2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 duly certified by the office of the regional provident fund commissioner or competent authority as per EPF Act should be uploaded in original.

ESI REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:- The agency must have valid ESI registration certificate issued by competent authority and attested remitted certificate of Contributions made for the past five financial years 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26. For minimum Rs.0.23 Lakhs (4% estimated cost) per annum from the concern department.

ANNUAL TURNOVER CETIFICATE:- The agency should submit the annual turnover for the financial years,2021-22,2022-23 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 for Rs.11.58 lakhs per annum. (for man power only) issued & certified by the chartered accountant along with UDIN number with Profit and loss sheets. (2% estimated cost)
